/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
command = ['node', '--test', '--test-name-pattern=规则遗漏、摘要漂移、批准不匹配和离线资源丢失阻断导出', 'scripts/verify-strategic-handoff-package-scenarios']
env = os.environ.copy()
env['TMPDIR'] = str(Path('.eval-tmp').resolve())
with Path('cross-repo.log').open('wb') as log:
    completed = subprocess.run(command, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, env=env)
print('exit_code=' + str(completed.returncode))
print(Path('cross-repo.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace'))
PY"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path
log = Path('cross-repo.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
count = re.search(r'"'^ℹ tests ('"\\d+)\\s*"'$'"', log, re.MULTILINE)
assert count, '日志中未找到实际测试数'
assert re.search(r'"'^ℹ pass 1'"\\s*"'$'"', log, re.MULTILINE)
assert re.search(r'"'^ℹ fail 0'"\\s*"'$'"', log, re.MULTILINE)
result = {
    'command': ['node', '--test', '--test-name-pattern=规则遗漏、摘要漂移、批准不匹配和离线资源丢失阻断导出', 'scripts/verify-strategic-handoff-package-scenarios'],
    'exit_code': 0,
    'actual_test_count': int(count.group(1)),
    'limitations': [
        '仅运行名称匹配的既有场景，实际为 1 个测试；未运行完整跨仓场景集。此次命令未报告缺失依赖。',
        'TMPDIR 指向 fixture 内既有的 .eval-tmp；cross-repo.log 原样保存命令合并后的 stdout 和 stderr。',
        '离线资源用例修改页面为引用 missing.png，并断言导出以“过期”拒绝；该断言不单独证明资源存在性检查。',
        '所有测试数据和批准均为 test-data-only，不构成真实项目批准、阶段流转或发布授权。',
        '未核验真实外部仓库、网络、构建、部署或交付；PATH 替身成功不代表真实构建或交付。'
    ]
}
output = Path('cross-repo-result.json')
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\\n', encoding='utf-8')
assert json.loads(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) == result
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
print('temporary_entries=' + json.dumps([p.name for p in Path('.eval-tmp').iterdir()], ensure_ascii=False))
PY"
